verdict.rationale: Orama Cloud officially supports JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, and Rust SDKs. The open-source JS library has extensive first-party API docs (create, insert/insertMultiple, vector/hybrid search, AnswerSession) and can be installed via npm, Deno, or a browser CDN. Its APIs are designed to mirror Orama Cloud, so code can move between the two. Missing for 10: in-depth evidence for the Python and Rust SDKs beyond a single listing line, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDKs' quality.
